editorial:
Imagine you finally get your big break, only to trip and fall right into a manhole. That is exactly what happens to Joe, a jazz teacher who thinks his whole life depends on playing a fancy club. You will love how the movie switches from the busy, colorful streets of New York City to the soft, glowing world of the You Seminar. It is a wild ride where Joe teams up with 22, a grumpy little soul who hates the idea of being human. Their chemistry is great, and the movie feels like a warm hug that asks you what actually makes life worth living.

The animation is stunning, and the music will stay in your head for days. While the middle part slows down a bit, the emotional payoff at the end is totally worth it. You should definitely watch this if you have been feeling burnt out or lost in your own career.
endingExplained: After Joe finally gets back to his body, he realizes that achieving his dream did not magically fix his life. He learns that the small things, like a falling leaf or a good slice of pizza, are what really matter. Joe lets 22 go to Earth to live her own life. In the end, Joe decides to keep teaching and playing music, but this time he promises to truly enjoy every single moment of his day.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves music, deep stories, and beautiful animation.
